style: Lucide-style outline icons, 1.75px-2px stroke, rounded joins, no fill except active/selected states.
density: one icon per feature tile / nav item; never decorative repeated rows
placement: inline with labels or inside a small rounded icon chip at the start of a card/nav item
domain_rule: home, courses (book-open), labs (flask-conical), AI playground (brain), learning paths (route), community (users), assistant/help (message-circle) — real product-navigation icons only
